translations.text: I therefore beg those who read this book not to lose heart over these sufferings, but to consider that these afflictions happen to our people not to destroy them, but to discipline them.
For this reason, he has not removed his mercy from us forever. Rather, while disciplining his people through afflictions, he does not abandon us.
Let us too die courageously, for the Lord God fights for us, as Moses said in his song that bears witness: “Compassion will be shown to his servants.”
After this, they brought in the third and demanded his tongue. He immediately put it out and raised his hands.
“I do not know how you came to be within me. Nor was it I who gave you life, breath, or the body of each of you.”
But you, unclean one, enemy of everyone, do not be vainly arrogant, relying on empty hopes, when you have risen up against the children of heaven.
